summary: In Python 3, dict.keys/values/items return view objects Ansible can't parse back into lists, so add | list for portability.
questions: Why does looping over dict.keys() fail on Python 3?
How do I loop over a dictionary's keys portably?

answer_card.title: Dictionary views need | list
answer_card.answer_md:
On Python 3, `dict.keys()`, `values()` and `items()` return view objects that Ansible can't turn back into lists. Add `| list`:

```yaml
loop: "{{ hosts.keys() | list }}"
```
